definitions.gloss: scattered, dotted about, spread here and there
definitions.explanation: Things being distributed or scattered across an area at intervals rather than clustered together. Used to describe the spatial distribution of buildings, islands, villages, and similar features.

examples.japanese: ⟦{湖|みずうみ}→湖：00867_mizuumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{小島|こじま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{点在|てんざい}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Small islands are scattered across the lake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{寺院|じいん}→寺院：00122_jiin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{点在|てんざい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Old temples are dotted throughout the mountains.

examples.japanese: ⟦{広大|こうだい}→広大：11328_koudai⟧な⟦{平原|へいげん}→平原：27685_heigen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{牧場|ぼくじょう}→牧場：06103_bokujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{点在|てんざい}し、⟦のどか→のどか：05709_nodoka⟧な⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: Ranches are scattered across the vast plain, creating a peaceful landscape.

notes:
{点在|てんざい} describes things being scattered or dotted across a wide area at intervals — not clustered together. Compound of ⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ (point, dot) + {在|ざい} (exist).

COMMON PATTERNS:
Almost always used as {点在|てんざい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ or {点在|てんざい}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧. The pattern ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{点在|てんざい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ means 'to be scattered across (a place).'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{点在|てんざい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: islands are scattered
- ⟦{集落|しゅうらく}→集落：19622_shuuraku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{点在|てんざい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: settlements are dotted about
- ⟦{遺跡|いせき}→遺跡：09527_iseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{点在|てんざい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: ruins are scattered
- ⟦{寺院|じいん}→寺院：00122_jiin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{点在|てんざい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: temples are dotted about

REGISTER:
Literary and descriptive — common in travel writing, geography descriptions, and formal prose. In casual speech, ⟦あちこち→あちこち：01687_achikochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to be here and there) is more natural.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{散在|さんざい}→散在：22748_sanzai⟧: scattered (similar but can imply more disorder)
- ⟦{散|ち}らばる→散らばる：12713_chirabaru⟧: to be scattered (more casual, can imply mess)
